body.label: Trigger
body.html: A wounded creature within weapon range fails an Action or Reaction.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Spend 2 Combo and attack the triggering creature. On a success, deal 1 weapon damage.

surges.html: After this Reaction resolves, you may suffer -1 Defense until your next turn to deal +1 weapon damage if this Reaction attacks.
If this Reaction deals damage, deal +1 weapon damage.
